title: Sensuela
writer: Regina Linnanheimo, Yrjö Norta, Alexander Pushkin
actors: Marianne Mardi, Ossi Elstelä, Mauritz Åkerman
plot: A Lappish girl, the only daughter of a reindeer herder, rescues a crashed German fighter pilot during WW2. The two develop warm feelings for each other during his convalescence.
